violations.title: Receiving Temperature, Refrigerated Foods
violations.observation: The following refrigerated food item(s) is received at inadequate temperatures: Observed Bean sprouts, half & half at 47, 51
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated time/temperature control for safety food shall be at a temperature of 41F or below when received. CFM was educated on control for safety food and receiving temperatures. CFM was advised to discarded Bean sprouts, half & half

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: Observed raw beef on top of vegetables in unit # 5
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CFM relocated raw beef to the bottom shelf

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours. Observed white rice, cooked noddles (17 hrs) in unit # 2 at 52, 52 F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. CFM discarded white rice, cooked noddles (17 hrs).

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: raw pork in unit # 4 at 46F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth.CFM discarded raw pork

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS EMAILED THE MANAGER THE WRITTEN PROCEDURES FOR HOW TO CLEAN UP ANY EVENTS OF VOMITING AND/OR DIARRHEA. PHO NGON RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 01/22/2026) Page 3 of 6

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: A food employee was observed drinking in areas where they may contaminate food, clean equipment, utensils or other items needing protection.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may only eat, drink, or use tobacco in a designated area like a dining room or office area. Employees shall not eat or drink in the kitchen areas, warewashing areas, or storage areas where items may become contaminated. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER THAT STAFF ARE ALLOWED TO HAVE BEVERAGES. THEY SHALL BE COVERED WITH A LID, CONSUMED THROUGH A STRAW, AND STORED BELOW WORK SURFACES. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Cleaning Procedure
violations.observation: Observed a food employee rinse off her gloved hands at the pre-scrape basin at the dish machine.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wash their hands and exposed portions of their arms by: 1) discarding used gloves; 2) rinsing under warm running water; 3) applying soap; 4) rubbing together for at least 10-15 seconds; 5) rinsing thoroughly under warm running water; and 6) drying with paper towels or air drying device. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO RE-TRAIN THE STAFF MEMBER ON HOW TO WASH HANDS. PROPER HAND WASHING ENTAILS USING A HAND SINK, WARM WATER, SOAP, RINSE WITH CLEAN WATER, AND PAPER TOWEL DRY HANDS. ENSURE MORE TRAINING AND CONTINUED CORRECTION WITH STAFF BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: Observed employees changing tasks and not changing their gloves or washing their hands.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO RE- TRAIN STAFF ON WHEN TO WASH THEIR HANDS. THIS INCLUDES WHEN THEY CHANGE TASKS. THE GLOVES ARE REMOVED, HANDS WASHED AT HAND SINKS, AND NEW, CLEAN GLOVES ARE PUT ON. ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in a food preparation sink or the pre-scrape basin of the dish machine area.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO RE-TRAIN STAFF ON WHERE THEY SHALL BE WASHING THEIR HANDS. HAND SINKS ONLY ARE DESIGNATED FOR HAND WASHING. ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: No bare hand contact with ready-to-eat food, or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed

violations.title: No Bare Hand Contact with RTE Foods
violations.observation: Food employee(s) was observed handling the following ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands: 1) WASHED BEAN SPROUTS.
violations.corrective_action: Except when washing fruits and vegetables, food employees may not contact ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands. Employees shall be using suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, or clean disposable gloves to handle all ready-to-eat foods. Proper handling of food and effective handwashing procedures will help prevent foodborne illness. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO DISCARD THE BEAN SPROUTS AND TRAIN STAFF TO HANDLE READY TO EAT FOODS USING UTENSILS OR GLOVED HANDS. ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: 1) OBSERVED RAW SEAFOOD AND BEEF STORED ABOVE CUT VEGETABLES INSIDE THE MAXX COLD 2DOOR UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO TRAIN STAFF THAT ALL RAW ANIMAL FOODS LIKE RAW EGGS, RAW PORK, RAW SEAFOOD, RAW BEEF, AND RAW CHICKEN ARE TO BE STORED BELOW ALL OTHER FOODS IN REFRIGERATION UNITS (AND FREEZER UNITS FOR A BEST PRACTICE). ENSURE TRAINING TO STAFF AND CONTINUED CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP. PHO NGON RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 01/22/2026) Page 2 of 6

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: 1) RED COLLANDER USED TO DRAIN COOKED NOODLES, 2) TONGS USED FOR COOKED MEATS. EHS OBSERVED THE STAFF MEMBERS ONLY RINSE THE ITEMS WITH WATER.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER THAT FOOD CONTACT SURFACES REQUIRE A WASH, RINSE, AND SANITIZING PROCESS AFTER USE. ENSURE TRAINING TO STAFF AND CONTINUED CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: 1) SEVERAL KNIVES ON THE MAGNETIC WALL STRIP ABOVE THE COOK LINE HAND SINK, 2) KNIFE UNDER THE SLICER, 3) SLICER.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER THAT FOOD CONTACT SURFACES AS LISTED ABOVE SHALL BE CLEANED AND SANITIZED EVERY 4 HOURS WHILE IN USE. ENSURE CORRECTION AND TRAINING TO STAFF BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Observed the interior of the ice machine unclean.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO CLEAN THE INTERIOR OF THE ICE MACHINE BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours: 1) COOKED RICE IN PORTIONED BAGS OBSERVED AT 44F-52F, 2) COOKED NOODLES IN PORTIONED BAGS AT 48F, 3) COOKED GINGER AND ONIONS SITTING OUT ROOM TEMPERATURE OVER NIGHT.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER THAT COOKED FOODS SHALL COOL RAPIDLY. THIS INVOLVES USING SHALLOW SHEET PANS, SMALL PORTIONS, ICE BATHS OR ICE WANDS, AND FREEZERS TO FACILITATE THE PROCESS. SEE FACT SHEET IN VIETNAMESE ON PROPER COOLING. ENSURE TRAINING TO STAFF AND CONTINUED CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP. FOODS WERE DISCARDED.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) COOKED NOODLES OBSERVED SITTING OUT AT ROOM TEMPERATURE AT 102F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER THAT HOT FOODS SHALL BE HELD AT 135F OR ABOVE UNLESS USING “TIME AS A PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL” CORRECTLY. NOODLES WERE DISCARDED. MANAGER INDICATED THAT SHE WOULD LIKE TO USE “TIME AS A PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL” MOVING FORWARD. SEE AGREEMENT DOCUMENT EXPLAINING HOW TO USE “TIME” EFFECTIVELY.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage-First Aid Supplies Not Contained
violations.observation: First Aid Supplies like NEOSPORIN are not being stored in a kit or container.
violations.corrective_action: Store all first aid supplies in a kit or container that is located to preclude the accidental contamination of food, food equipment, and other food contact surfaces. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO STORE ALL PERSONAL CARE ITEMS LIKE FIRST AIR ITEMS IN A SEPARATE LOCATION AWAY FROM FOOD, CLEAN EQUIPMENT, CLEAN UTENSILS, SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS, AND CLEAN LINENS. MANAGER WILL DESIGNATE ONE LOCATION FOR STORAGE OF ALL PERSONAL CARE ITEMS BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Observed a spray bottle containing a chemical unlabeled.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO LABEL ALL CHEMICALS WHEN TRANSFERRED FROM THE ORIGINAL CONTAINER INTO A WORKING CONTAINER. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Cooling in Equipment
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: 1) OBSERVED PORTIONED BAGS OF RICE AND NOODLES STORED IN SEALED PLASTIC BAGS INSIDE REACH-IN REFRIGERATION UNITS AT THE COOK LINE, 2) OBSERVED COOKED ONIONS AND GINGER SITTING OUT OVER NIGHT AT ROOM TEMPERATURE.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. EHS DISCUSSED AND EDUCATED MANAGEMENT ON PROPER COOLING METHODS. SEE FACT SHEET ON PROPER COOLING AND ENSURE TRAINING TO STAFF BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: 1) RAW BEEF AND SEAFOOD BEING THAWED AT ROOM TEMPERATURE.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO THAW FROZEN FOODS UNDER REFRIGERATION, UNDER RUNNING WATER, OR BY COOKING FROM FROZNE. ENSURE TRAINING TO STAFF AND CONTINUED CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP. PHO NGON RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 01/22/2026) Page 4 of 6

violations.title: Food Thermometer, Repair and Calibration
violations.observation: The digital food temperature measuring device was observed at 36.2f in the ice water bath.
violations.corrective_action: Food thermometers shall be calibrated in accordance with manufacturer's specifications as necessary to ensure their accuracy. It is suggested that food thermometers be calibrated at least once a week in a cup completely filled with ice and cold water to a temperature of 32F or calibrated in a pot of boiling water at 212F. EHS EDUCATED THE MANAGER THAT THE DIGITAL FOOD THERMOMETER SHALL READ 32F IN THE ICE WATER BATH. PROVIDE A NEW DIGITAL FOOD THERMOMETER BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP. THE UNUSED DIAL THERMOMETER PROVIDED DURING THE INSPECTION ONLY WILL WORK FOR HOT FOODS AS IT IS A THERMOMETER DESIGNED FOR USE IN STEAMING MILK FOR ESPRESSO BEVERAGES.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: 1) WORKING CONTAINERS OF BULK FOOD ITEMS (E.G. SUGAR, SALT, RICE), 2) WORKING CONTAINERS OF DRY SEASONINGS, 3) BOTTLES OF OILS, SAUCES, SIMPLE SYRUP, SWEETENED CONDENSED MILK, ETC.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER THAT ALL WORKING CONTAINERS OF FOODS IN BULK BINS, BOTTLES, ETC SHALL BE LABELED. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed food directly stored on the floor in the kitchen areas.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER THAT ALL FOOD SHALL BE STORED ON NSF APPROVED SHELVING UNITS OR DUNNAGE RACKS AT LEAST 6 INCHES OFF THE FLOOR. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Employees observed working in the food service area without proper hair restraints.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER THAT ALL STAFF PREPARING FOOD SHALL WEAR HATS OR HAIR NETS. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO REUSE THE FRESH PEELED GARLIC CONTAINERS FOR WET CLOTH BUCKETS. ENSURE THE BLEACH WATER SOLUTION IN THE BUCKET IS MAINTAINED AT 50-200PPM AND ONE TOWEL PER BUCKET. ONLY CLEAN, DRY TOWELS MAY BE STORED ON WORK SURFACES. ENSURE TRAINING TO STAFF AND CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: 1) OBSERVED UTENSILS STORED IN STANDING, ROOM TEMPERATURE WATER, 2) OBSERVED THE ICE SCOOP LYING IN THE ICE MACHINE, 3) OBSERVED PLASTIC CUPS OR SMALL CONDIMENT CUPS BEING USED TO DISPENSE BULK FOODS LIKE MACHA POWDER, DRY TEA LEAVES, SUGAR, RICE, ETC.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER THAT ALL IN-USE UTENSILS SHALL BE DESIGNED WITH A HANDLE. THE HANDLE WILL SIT UP, OUT OF THE FOOD. NO WATER FOR STORAGE OF IN-USE UTENSILS UNLESS THE WATER IS CONSTANTLY RUNNING OR MAINTAINED AT 135F OR ABOVE. ENSURE TRAINING TO STAFF BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equipment/Utensils Air Drying
violations.observation: Observed staff stacking cleaned and sanitized mixing bowls and colanders while still wet.
violations.corrective_action: After cleaning and sanitizing, equipment and utensils shall be air-dried or used after adequate draining before contact with food. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER THAT ALL CLEANED AND SANITIZED EQUIPMENT AND UTENSILS SHALL BE AIR DRIED BEFORE BEING PUT AWAY ON SHELVES. ENSURE TRAINING TO STAFF BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers for fresh peeled garlic and white plastic containers are observed reused for the storage of other foods.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO STOP THE REUSE OF MANUFACTURER CONTAINERS. THE ONLY CONTAINERS ALLOWED FOR REUSE ARE THE 5 GALLON SOY SAUCE BUCKETS; NO LIDS. ENSURE ALL FOOD CONTAINERS THAT ARE REUSED ARE NSF APPROVED AND DESIGNED FOR CONTINUOUS WARE WASHING PROCESSES. EHS POINTED OUT THE CORRECT TYPES OF CONTAINERS. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: Milk crates and black produce crates used for the storage of food, equipment, utensils, etc.
violations.corrective_action: Milk crates, soda crates, and/or bread racks are not designed to store or elevate food, equipment, utensils, clean linens, and single-service items. Provide only ANSI-certified (such as NSF-listed) shelving units, storage units, or dunnage racks. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO REPLACE ANY CRATES WITH NSF APPROVED FOOD CONTAINERS. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Corrosion-Resistant/Nonabsorbent Materials
violations.observation: Observed plastic grocery store and take out bags used for food storage.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be durable, corrosion-resistant, and nonabsorbent. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO DISCONTINUE THE USE OF PLASTIC GROCERY STORE AND TAKE OUT BAGS FOR FOOD STORAGE. REPLACE WITH NSF APPROVED FOOD CONTAINERS. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Toilet Rooms Enclosed
violations.observation: Toilet room door is not provided with a self-closing door.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a self-closing hinge or closing mechanism for the toilet room door. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO INSTALL A SELF CLOSING DOOR HINGE ON THE RESTROOM DOOR BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed the kitchen floors in need of cleaning behind the cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO CLEAN THE FLOORS BEHIND THE COOK LINE TO REMOVE THE EXCESS GREASE AND FOOD RESIDUE BUILD UP. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Mops Allowed to Air Dry
violations.observation: Observed that mops are improperly stored between use.
violations.corrective_action: Store mops in a position that allows them to air dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO RINSE OUT AND HANG UP THE WET MOPS AFTER USE TO ALLOW FOR AIR DRYING. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Receiving Temperature, Refrigerated Foods
violations.observation: The following refrigerated food item(s) is received at inadequate temperatures: Observed Bean sprouts in unit # 1 at 77F
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated time/temperature control for safety food shall be at a temperature of 41F or below when received. EHS Trained staff to use a calibrated food thermometer to verify product temperatures at the time of delivery. Supplier must be notified.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: Observed raw chicken on top of raw beef in the freezer
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). CFM relocated raw chicken to the bottom shelf

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: Observed ice machine=ne I n the kitchen soiled
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. CFM will deep clean the ice machine and follow up on this with the HD.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: Observed raw chicken thawing in a counter a room temperature
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. CFM relocated raw chicken to the refrigerator

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. CFM will attain a food thermometer

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Observed flour stored on the floor under the service table in the cook area
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. CFM discarded flour

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. Observed wet wiping clothes on the counter in the kitchen
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. CFM prepared a sanitizer bucket and stored wet wiping clothes.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: observed rice scoops in standing 78F water
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. CFM washed, rinsed and sanitized scoops and stored them in a metal container in 137F water on the grill
